notes.title: Captain 13 - Beyond the Hero [IMPORTANT UPDATE]
notes.content:
Hello Captains,

First, let us thank you for buying and playing our game. There's a few things we devs are working on and wanted to keep you updated about. 

1) We've updated our game and released a NON-VR version of Captain 13. 

2) We're aware of an unpredictable bug that causes the game to crash within 5-10 minutes of playing it. We narrowed down the cause of the issue and will release a temporary patch to fix the problem by the end of today (Thursday, 10/05/2017). We will continue iterating through the work, making sure the issue does not repeat again.

Please be patient as we continue updating the game on a daily basis. For any bug reports, start a discussion on https://community.zombiesoup.com/ to make us aware of the issue, or here on CPT13 Steam Community hub. 


Good luck, Captains!
